# Mode

Finds the number that occurs most often in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Mode(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array of numbers. Numbers equal in value count as the same, so `1` and `1.0` are one number. A null element is skipped; any other element that is not a number is a runtime error. Null is read as an empty array, and a value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The number that occurs most often, as it first appears in the array; when several occur equally often, the one that appears first. Null when the array holds no numbers: when it is empty, null, or holds only null elements.

## Example

`Mode([1, 2, 2, 3, 3])` returns `2`.

`Mode([])` returns null.
